INFO.name: QUERY
INFO.value: SELECT TOP 999 SOURCEID,SOURCENAME,FRAMESETID,RA2000,DEC2000,YAPERMAG3,YAPERMAG3ERR,JAPERMAG3,JAPERMAG3ERR,HAPERMAG3,HAPERMAG3ERR,KSAPERMAG3,KSAPERMAG3ERR FROM VHS_CAT_V3 WHERE RA2000 >= 52.931224363898 AND RA2000 <= 52.937891030565 AND DEC2000 >= -28.047884931580 AND DEC2000 <= -28.041218264914

FIELD.name: SOURCEID
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UID of this merged detection as assigned by merge algorithm

FIELD.name: FRAMESETID
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UID of the set of frames that this merged source comes from

FIELD.name: YAPERMAG3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Default point source Y aperture corrected mag (2.0 arcsec diam)

FIELD.name: YAPERMAG3ERR
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in default point/extended source Y mag

FIELD.name: JAPERMAG3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Default point source J aperture corrected mag (2.0 arcsec diam)

FIELD.name: JAPERMAG3ERR
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in default point/extended source J mag

FIELD.name: HAPERMAG3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Default point source H aperture corrected mag (2.0 arcsec diam)

FIELD.name: HAPERMAG3ERR
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in default point/extended source H mag

FIELD.name: KSAPERMAG3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Default point source Ks aperture corrected mag (2.0 arcsec diam)

FIELD.name: KSAPERMAG3ERR
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in default point/extended source Ks mag
